mechanism: LLM paraphrases or infers status instead of reading the authoritative monthly IRS/OFAC data; stale snapshot; name/EIN confusion
evidence_or_analogue: Legal RAG tools hallucinated 17-33% on legal queries (Magesh et al.); IRS ARL published monthly
regulatory_hook: 4966 taxable distribution (20% on sponsor, 5% on manager) ; ARL reliance
likelihood_scenario: Low if AI is excluded from status lookup; Medium if AI summarizes status
ai_effect_on_risk: creates (if AI replaces lookup) / none (if lookup stays deterministic)
deterministic_controls: EIN-keyed lookup against dated IRS bulk files and SDN list; snapshot hash stored with decision
permitted_ai_role: None for status; may summarize non-standard documents
human_decision_required: Any non-standard grantee; any conflicting source
monitoring_metric: % decisions with source snapshot id; status-change alerts acted within SLA

mechanism: Over-sensitive screening, misread purpose text, adverse media false positives
evidence_or_analogue: Benevity reports external match decline fell from 30% to <3% after AI receipt reading (vendor) — shows decline rates are material and movable
deterministic_controls: Appeal path; reason codes; hold timers
permitted_ai_role: Draft reason text; suggest missing documents
monitoring_metric: Hold rate, appeal overturn rate, time-in-hold

mechanism: Fuzzy matching or LLM similarity over-flags common names
ai_effect_on_risk: redistributes (fewer manual reads, but new triage errors)
deterministic_controls: Deterministic list match with tuned thresholds; secondary identifiers
monitoring_metric: Alert volume, analyst disposition time, auto-clear rate (target 0 for list hits)

failure_mode: Missed sanctions hit or prohibited benefit
mechanism: AI triage auto-clears; purpose text hides benefit (tickets, tuition, pledge); OFAC strict-liability context
evidence_or_analogue: Automation bias literature: users over-rely on automated aids (Goddard et al. 2012)
regulatory_hook: OFAC; 4967 (125% on donor/advisor); 4958(c)(2) automatic excess benefit
ai_effect_on_risk: creates if AI may clear; reduces if AI only adds flags
deterministic_controls: AI may add, never remove, a flag; structured attestation at intake
monitoring_metric: Sampled QA of cleared cases; seeded test cases

mechanism: Chatbot gives wrong deductibility, QCD, OBBBA 2026 rule or 4967 answer
evidence_or_analogue: Moffatt v. Air Canada (2024 BCCRT 149): firm liable for chatbot misstatement; Magesh et al. legal hallucination rates
regulatory_hook: Consumer protection; for affiliated broker-dealers FINRA communications rules apply technology-neutrally (RN 24-09)
deterministic_controls: Retrieval only from approved, versioned content; refusal for individualized tax advice; disclaimers
monitoring_metric: Citation coverage; sampled answer accuracy; escalation rate

failure_mode: Unauthorized or erroneous grant action by an agent
mechanism: Agent misparses request, acts on injected instruction, or exceeds scope; irrevocable once paid
evidence_or_analogue: Daffy MCP exposes make_donation ('moves real money') with no documented per-donation limit; TIFIN Louise 'executes real donor requests'
regulatory_hook: 4966 sponsor 'exclusive legal control'; FINRA 2026 report flags agents exceeding user authority
deterministic_controls: Recommendation and sponsor approval as separate states; per-action confirmation; amount/recipient limits; cancel window before payout; agent identity in audit log
human_decision_required: Donor confirmation of each recommendation; sponsor approval
monitoring_metric: Agent-originated share; cancel/reversal rate of agent-originated grants

mechanism: Provider updates or model swaps change outputs without code change
evidence_or_analogue: Chen, Zaharia, Zou (2023) documented behavior change in GPT-3.5/4 across months; Anthropic retires models with >=60 days notice
deterministic_controls: Pinned model versions; regression suite of labeled cases run before any model change
monitoring_metric: Regression pass rate; output distribution shift

mechanism: Recommender favors partners, large/online-visible charities, or paid placement; opaque ranking
evidence_or_analogue: TIFIN Louise ranks charities from giving history/location; Fidelity-hosted survey: 39.8% of donors uneasy about data use
regulatory_hook: Donor-advisor privilege is advisory; sponsor neutrality norms; Colorado AI Act (consequential decisions) status uncertain
deterministic_controls: Disclose ranking factors; no paid placement; diversity checks
monitoring_metric: Recommendation concentration (HHI) across recipients; disclosure presence

mechanism: Donor PII/holdings/beneficiary data sent to third-party model or retained; connector over-permission
evidence_or_analogue: Fidelity Charitable virtual assistant asks users not to enter personal data; Oregon privacy law applies to nonprofits from 2025-07-01
regulatory_hook: State privacy laws (Oregon, Colorado cover nonprofits); NIST GenAI data privacy risk
deterministic_controls: Data minimization; no-training/zero-retention terms; field-level redaction; DPA

mechanism: AI suggestions not logged with inputs, model version, prompt and reviewer action
evidence_or_analogue: FINRA flags agent auditability of multi-step chains
regulatory_hook: Sponsor must evidence control over distributions (4966); 990/audit
deterministic_controls: Immutable decision record: inputs, sources, model id, output, human action

mechanism: Approval rationale is a fluent narrative not tied to evidence
evidence_or_analogue: Magesh et al.: RAG reduces but does not remove fabricated support
deterministic_controls: Rationale must cite source document spans; reason codes from fixed taxonomy

mechanism: Reviewers rubber-stamp AI suggestions; sampled QA decays
evidence_or_analogue: Goddard et al. systematic review on automation bias
deterministic_controls: Seeded known-bad cases; reviewer override statistics; rotation

mechanism: Retirement, pricing or policy change of model; outage
evidence_or_analogue: Anthropic deprecation page: >=60 days notice; e.g., Claude Sonnet 4 retired 2026-06-15
regulatory_hook: Vendor management (OFAC Framework mgmt commitment; FINRA vendor risk)
deterministic_controls: Abstraction layer; multi-model eval; manual fallback path

mechanism: Decision rationale and evidence held in vendor format; switching loses provenance
evidence_or_analogue: Repo prior finding: portable case record is a gap (batch-2a)
deterministic_controls: Contractual export of decision records in open schema

failure_mode: Prompt injection via charity or donor-supplied data
mechanism: Instructions embedded in charity websites, PDFs, grant purpose text or remittance memos alter agent behavior
evidence_or_analogue: Greshake et al. 2023 demonstrated indirect prompt injection; OWASP LLM01 (prompt injection) and LLM06 (excessive agency)
likelihood_scenario: Medium-High where AI reads external content and holds tools
deterministic_controls: Treat external text as data; no tool access in document-reading steps; output schema validation
permitted_ai_role: Extract fields from untrusted docs in sandbox

mechanism: Leaked API key or OAuth token lets an agent move funds
evidence_or_analogue: Daffy docs: API key 'can move money in your fund'; treat like a password
regulatory_hook: State privacy breach laws; sponsor cybersecurity
deterministic_controls: Scoped tokens; spend limits; revocation; anomaly detection on agent-originated grants
